chosenApproach: Extract strictly one source cell per rank from owner-approved sheets, alpha-isolate 40 silhouettes, pack a local static WebP atlas, use the existing shared ProfileAvatar with batched server rank lookup and a single foreground-aware presence channel.
selectionRationale: Original approved emblems preserve individual silhouettes; a static atlas avoids 40 separate network fetches and bounded rank batching avoids per-avatar server RPCs.
